scale: Answers run from -2 (strongly disagree) to +2 (strongly agree). agreeLeans: -1 = agreeing is the more left-leaning answer, +1 = more right-leaning, 0 = doesn't map cleanly onto left/right and is not counted.

issues.title: Universal healthcare
issues.statement: The government should guarantee health insurance for everyone.

issues.title: Abortion
issues.statement: Abortion should be legal in most or all cases.

issues.title: Gun control
issues.statement: Laws restricting gun ownership should be stricter.

issues.title: Iran war
issues.statement: The U.S. should end its military campaign against Iran.

issues.title: ICE & immigration enforcement
issues.statement: Federal funding for immigration enforcement (ICE and Border Patrol) should be increased.

issues.title: Voter ID
issues.statement: Voters should be required to show photo ID to vote.

issues.title: Tariffs
issues.statement: Tariffs on imported goods are a good way to protect American jobs.

issues.title: Death penalty
issues.statement: The death penalty should be a legal punishment for the most serious crimes.

issues.title: Religion & government
issues.statement: Religious values should play a role in shaping public policy.

issues.title: Marijuana
issues.statement: Marijuana should be legal for adult recreational use nationwide.

issues.title: Transgender athletes
issues.statement: Transgender girls and women should be barred from competing in girls' and women's school sports.

issues.title: Government assistance programs
issues.statement: Government assistance programs for low-income people should be expanded.

issues.title: Presidential war powers
issues.statement: The president should need Congress's approval before launching military strikes on another country.

issues.title: Deportation
issues.statement: People living in the U.S. illegally should be deported.

issues.title: Path to citizenship
issues.statement: People living in the U.S. illegally should have a way to earn legal status.
